theme.label: Theme
steps: Add the token to :root in globals.css
Give it a value in both light and dark blocks
Read it in components with var(--token)

routes.label: Routes
steps: Drop a page.tsx in src/app — the folder is the path
Add a matching NavLink in app-shell.tsx

store.label: Store
steps: Define an atom beside the store
The provider tree in layout.tsx already holds it
Read and write it with useAtom()

footer.title: Start building
footer.description: Open src/app/page.tsx and replace this screen with your own.
